quarterly_data.signal: ALD progress (2025 annual report): PE-ALD tools built on the VS-300T platform kept winning customer orders for multiple tools and shipping, with customer validation progressing smoothly; the company says the tool can be used for double / multiple patterning in advanced logic and memory chips and for TSV isolation (liner) layers in advanced packaging. Its Thermal-ALD tools are in industrial use (Al2O3, AlN, TiN, TiON films) and kept winning orders and shipping; the TiN process tool passed customer validation and now covers advanced-logic and advanced-packaging customers.
